policy: Named, individually printed dates only. Do not recur to intervening Sundays or extrapolate 2027 from a 2026 document
Publication of a planned Mass in the bulletin is not proof of on-the-day occurrence or real-time availability; confirm with chapel before travel
Confession at 08:00 is NOT a Mass and must not appear in the events list
Duplicate CL2 physical aliases and historical 296-row source claims do not create additional events
Location, provider, liturgical books and canonical status remain independent source scopes; no Una Cum or named Pope inference
Event times use the chapel's own Pacific/Noumea civil time with no user-timezone conversion
